log.text: Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Politoed

decisions.rationale: Mega Scizor. Lead Politoed+Archaludon: Drizzle auto-rain gives instant Electro Shot and rain-boosted Hydro Pump (SE vs Mudsdale). Archaludon resists Make It Rain (NVE) and Heat Wave is rain-halved. Protect T1 if Farigiraf leads expecting TR. Back Grimmsnarl sets Prankster Reflect to survive TR physical attackers and OHKOs Hydreigon with 4x SE Play Rough while walling its kit. Mega Scizor walls Azumarill and cleans late with Technician Bullet Punch.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster: Farigiraf(Quiet,MentalHerb,ArmorTail—blocks priority targeting their side incl FakeOut/BulletPunch; TR setter), Gholdengo(Modest,LifeOrb,GoodAsGold—blocks status moves), Hydreigon(Modest,ChoiceScarf,Levitate,118-150Spe), Rotom-Wash(Bold,Sitrus,Levitate), Azumarill(Adamant,ExpertBelt,HugePower), Mudsdale(Brave,Leftovers,Stamina). Key type facts verified: Draco Meteor neutral vs Archaludon(Steel/Dragon), Electro Shot neutral vs Rotom-Wash and Gholdengo, Hydro Pump SE vs Mudsdale(rain-boosted), Make It Rain NVE vs Archaludon, Heat Wave neutral but rain-halved to 0.5x, Earthquake SE vs Gholdengo but hits ally, Play Rough 4x SE vs Hydreigon(Grimmsnarl OHKOs). Grimmsnarl walls Hydreigon: Dark Pulse double NVE, Draco Meteor NVE, Earth Power NVE, Heat Wave neutral but rain-weakened. Archaludon walls Rotom-Wash+Azumarill offensively (most moves double NVE). Mega Scizor walls Azumarill. Plan: rain core lead, switch to Grimmsnarl for Reflect+Hydreigon answer, Mega Scizor for Azumarill wall/cleanup. Watch Farigiraf TR T1; Protect through it if needed.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf sets Trick Room while Armor Tail blocks all opposing priority (Scizor/Grimmsnarl/Staraptor). Mudsdale under TR outspeeds nearly all foes and Body Presses Archaludon or Heavy Slams Grimmsnarl/Scizor. Backline Gholdengo cleanup and Rotom-Wash burn/rain check complete the mode.
decisions.notebook: Opponent has Scizorite (Mega Scizor, Technician priority), Drizzle Politoed, Archaludon (Stamina), Noivern (Life Orb), Grimmsnarl (Prankster screens), Staraptor (Focus Sash Intimidate). My Armor Tail invalidates their priority core. Trick Room turns Mudsdale and Azumarill into speed advantages. If opponent leads Politoed + Archaludon, rain powers Electro Shot and Hydro Pump, so Rotom-Wash backline handles it. Plan: game 1 lead Farigiraf + Mudsdale to TR immediately; adapt to rain by protecting key pieces.

decisions.rationale: Double into Farigiraf to KO before Trick Room resolves (pri -7 goes last). Electro Shot 31-71% + Hydro Pump 38-88% = 69-159% combined, likely KO if both connect. Preventing TR preserves my speed advantage (Arch 125 > Politoed 90 > both foes). Hydro Pump 80% acc is the main risk, but preventing TR is worth it — their entire team is built for reversed speed. Mudsdale Body Press does 32-56% to Archaludon, survivable. If Farigiraf falls, 2v1 vs Mudsdale under normal speed is favorable.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster: Farigiraf(Quiet,MentalHerb,ArmorTail—blocks priority targeting their side incl FakeOut/BulletPunch; TR setter), Gholdengo(Modest,LifeOrb,GoodAsGold—blocks status moves), Hydreigon(Modest,ChoiceScarf,Levitate,118-150Spe), Rotom-Wash(Bold,Sitrus,Levitate), Azumarill(Adamant,ExpertBelt,HugePower), Mudsdale(Brave,Leftovers,Stamina). Key type facts verified: Draco Meteor neutral vs Archaludon(Steel/Dragon), Electro Shot neutral vs Rotom-Wash and Gholdengo, Hydro Pump SE vs Mudsdale(rain-boosted), Make It Rain NVE vs Archaludon, Heat Wave neutral but rain-halved to 0.5x, Earthquake SE vs Gholdengo but hits ally, Play Rough 4x SE vs Hydreigon(Grimmsnarl OHKOs). Grimmsnarl walls Hydreigon: Dark Pulse double NVE, Draco Meteor NVE, Earth Power NVE, Heat Wave neutral but rain-weakened. Archaludon walls Rotom-Wash+Azumarill offensively (most moves double NVE). Mega Scizor walls Azumarill. Damage verified T1: Archaludon Electro Shot vs Farigiraf 31-71%, Politoed Hydro Pump vs Farigiraf 38-88%, combined 69-159% likely KO. Politoed Hydro Pump vs Mudsdale 77-166% possible OHKO. Mudsdale Body Press vs Archaludon 32-56%. Plan: rain core lead, try to KO Farigiraf T1 to prevent TR; if TR goes up, switch to Grimmsnarl for Reflect+Hydreigon answer, Mega Scizor for Azumarill wall/cleanup. Watch for Farigiraf Protect reads.

decisions.rationale: Both opponents out-speed our leads and have rain-boosted attacks that threaten immediate KOs on both Pokémon. Protecting both ensures survival, wastes a rain turn, and lets Farigiraf set Trick Room fresh next turn, which reverses speed for Mudsdale and Rotom-Wash.
decisions.notebook: Opponent has Drizzle Politoed + Stamina Archaludon lead; rain powers their special attackers. Armor Tail blocks their priority core (Scizor, Grimmsnarl). Trick Room flips speed for Mudsdale, Rotom-Wash. Key endgame: TR up lets Mudsdale and Rotom-Wash outrun their faster threats. Need to wear down Archaludon before Stamina stacks.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf's Trick Room at priority -7 goes last, so both my faster attackers hit first. Electro Shot (130 BP, +1 SpA from T1, another +1 from charge this turn) + rain-boosted Hydro Pump combined ~79-183% likely KOs Farigiraf before TR resolves. Preventing TR is critical — their team is TR-built and I lose the speed game under it. Mudsdale EQ risk to Archaludon is real but opponent likely prefers Body Press to avoid hitting ally. Accept the trade risk over letting TR go up.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster: Farigiraf(Quiet,MentalHerb,ArmorTail—blocks priority targeting their side incl FakeOut/BulletPunch; TR setter), Gholdengo(Modest,LifeOrb,GoodAsGold—blocks status moves), Hydreigon(Modest,ChoiceScarf,Levitate,118-150Spe), Rotom-Wash(Bold,Sitrus,Levitate), Azumarill(Adamant,ExpertBelt,HugePower), Mudsdale(Brave,Leftovers,Stamina). Key type facts verified: Draco Meteor neutral vs Archaludon(Steel/Dragon), Electro Shot neutral vs Rotom-Wash and Gholdengo, Hydro Pump SE vs Mudsdale(rain-boosted), Make It Rain NVE vs Archaludon, Heat Wave neutral but rain-halved to 0.5x, Earthquake SE vs Gholdengo but hits ally, Play Rough 4x SE vs Hydreigon(Grimmsnarl OHKOs). Grimmsnarl walls Hydreigon: Dark Pulse double NVE, Draco Meteor NVE, Earth Power NVE, Heat Wave neutral but rain-weakened. Archaludon walls Rotom-Wash+Azumarill offensively (most moves double NVE). Mega Scizor walls Azumarill. Electro Shot does NOT double power in rain — only skips charge turn and gives +1 SpA on charge. Mudsdale EQ spread vs Archaludon 76-130% possible OHKO. Plan: rain core lead, try to KO Farigiraf T1 to prevent TR; if TR goes up, switch to Grimmsnarl for Reflect+Hydreigon answer, Mega Scizor for Azumarill wall/cleanup. Watch for Farigiraf Protect reads.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Mudsdale)
decisions.rationale: Politoed's rain-boosted Hydro Pump OHKOs Mudsdale (101.5-153.8%). Mudsdale must switch out. Gholdengo (Steel/Ghost) resists Archaludon's Flash Cannon (12.9-29%) and takes neutral Hydro Pump (37.6-87%, no OHKO). Farigiraf survives Flash Cannon (34.8-58.5%) and sets Trick Room at -7 priority after taking damage. If Politoed targeted Mudsdale, the move fails after the switch. Next turn under TR, Mudsdale (49 Speed) outspeeds both foes, and Gholdengo + Farigiraf can attack safely.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads Politoed+Drizzle+Archaludon. Rain is up 4 more turns. Politoed Hydro Pump is an OHKO on Mudsdale. Archaludon has +1 SpA from Electro Shot last turn. Armor Tail blocks their priority core. Key endgame plan: TR up lets Mudsdale and Rotom-Wash outrun faster threats. Gholdengo's Good as Gold blocks status. Need to wear down Archaludon before Stamina stacks.

decisions.rationale: Rotom-Wash resists Hydro Pump, immune to Earthquake, and survives boosted Electro Shot with Sitrus Berry. Mudsdale risks OHKO from rain-boosted Hydro Pump. Gholdengo Pass forces us to rely on the switch-in alone this turn.
decisions.notebook: Rain 4 turns left. Opponent Politoed/Archaludon with +2 SpA Archaludon. Farigiraf fainted; Gholdengo healthy. Goal: get Trick Room up with Mudsdale or Rotom-Wash to outspeed faster threats. Rotom-Wash can burn Archaludon next turn. Opponent lacks switch advantage; no Terastal used yet. Watch for Grimmsnarl/Noivern in back; Armor Tail blocks their priority. Scizor-Mega and Staraptor physical threats; burn will cripple them.

decisions.rationale: Electro Shot is neutral vs Gholdengo (not NVE as state chart says). With +2 SpA and Helping Hand, Electro Shot reaches ~94-209% — near-guaranteed OHKO on Gholdengo, removing the only Focus Blast threat. Archaludon then walls Rotom-Wash completely (all moves 0.5x). Politoed survives Thunderbolt (46-84%, not OHKO). Opponent is behind after losing Farigiraf and likely goes aggressive rather than Protecting. 70% Focus Blast accuracy and speed uncertainty favor pressing the advantage.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster: Farigiraf(Quiet,MentalHerb,ArmorTail—blocks priority targeting their side incl FakeOut/BulletPunch; TR setter), Gholdengo(Modest,LifeOrb,GoodAsGold—blocks status moves), Hydreigon(Modest,ChoiceScarf,Levitate,118-150Spe), Rotom-Wash(Bold,Sitrus,Levitate), Azumarill(Adamant,ExpertBelt,HugePower), Mudsdale(Brave,Leftovers,Stamina). Key type facts verified: Electric NEUTRAL vs Steel/Ghost Gholdengo (not NVE—state chart was wrong); Electro Shot neutral vs both Gholdengo and Rotom-Wash (Electric 0.5x vs Electric, 2x vs Water = 1x net). Archaludon walls Rotom-Wash offensively (Thunderbolt 0.5x, Hydro Pump 0.5x). Focus Blast 2x SE vs Archaludon possible OHKO 97-201% but 70% acc. Grimmsnarl walls Hydreigon: Dark Pulse double NVE, Draco Meteor NVE, Earth Power NVE, Heat Wave neutral but rain-weakened. Play Rough 4x SE vs Hydreigon. Mega Scizor walls Azumarill. Mudsdale EQ possible OHKO 76-130% vs Archaludon. Plan: rain core lead, KO Farigiraf T1 to prevent TR (achieved T2); if TR goes up, switch to Grimmsnarl for Reflect+Hydreigon answer, Mega Scizor for Azumarill wall/cleanup. Archaludon +2 SpA is key win condition—protect it from Focus Blast by removing Gholdengo ASAP.

decisions.rationale: Grimmsnarl's Fake Out (+3 priority, Armor Tail gone) flinches Gholdengo before Make It Rain, opening a rain-boosted Hydro Pump KO window on 90% Gholdengo. Grimmsnarl also brings Reflect for Mudsdale EQ and Parting Shot for Rotom-Wash. Scizor resists Make It Rain but has zero SE moves vs any remaining foe and is 2x weak to EQ + Wisp-vulnerable. Grimmsnarl enables a win path; Scizor is dead weight.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster: Farigiraf(Quiet,MentalHerb,ArmorTail—fainted G1; blocks priority targeting their side), Gholdengo(Modest,LifeOrb,GoodAsGold—blocks status moves targeting it; Make It Rain spread 2x SE vs Dark/Fairy, possible OHKO on Grimmsnarl even at 0.75x spread), Hydreigon(Modest,ChoiceScarf,Levitate,118-150Spe—not brought G1), Rotom-Wash(Bold,Sitrus,Levitate,106-138Spe; Thunderbolt possible OHKO on Politoed 36-117.6%), Azumarill(Adamant,ExpertBelt,HugePower—not brought G1), Mudsdale(Brave,Leftovers,Stamina,49-78Spe; EQ 2x SE vs Scizor, Heavy Slam 4x SE vs Grimmsnarl). Key damage: Politoed rain Hydro Pump vs Gholdengo 31.4-108% (possible OHKO on 90% target). Politoed Hydro Pump 2x SE vs Mudsdale. Scizor has no SE moves vs any opponent remaining (Close Combat immune to Gholdengo Ghost, BP 0.25x vs Rotom-Wash, all neutral vs Mudsdale). Grimmsnarl Fake Out now works (Armor Tail/Farigiraf fainted). Plan: bring Grimmsnarl, Fake Out Gholdengo to deny Make It Rain, try to KO Gholdengo with rain Hydro Pump ASAP. If Gholdengo removed, Politoed+Grimmsnarl handle Rotom-Wash+Mudsdale via Reflect/Parting Shot support and SE Hydro Pump on Mudsdale. Scizor reserved as last-resort pivot only.

decisions.rationale: Will-O-Wisp burns Archaludon, halving Earthquake. Focus Blast super-effective likely KOs or cripples; Gholdengo outspeeds to act first. If Focus Blast misses, burn still reduces physical threat. Rotom resists Politoed's special attacks. High reward line to break their core.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads Politoed/Archaludon; Rain 3 turns left. Archaludon +2 SpA, can 1-turn Electro Shot in rain. Gholdengo's GoodasGold blocks status. Farigiraf fainted; Mudsdale/Rotom-Wash in back. Priority to burn physical threats (Archaludon, later Scizor-Mega, Staraptor). Grimmsnarl/Noivern in back; Armor Tail blocks their priority. Future plan: get Trick Room from Mudsdale to handle speed.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out (+3 pri) flinches Rotom-Wash, denying Thunderbolt (44-96% to Politoed). Politoed only takes 14-31% from spread Make It Rain (0.5x). Hydro Pump chips Gholdengo to -7-42% with LO recoil—possible KO. Even if Grimmsnarl falls to Make It Rain (67-151%), Politoed at 69-86% finishes Gholdengo next turn. Last turn Fake Out is usable.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster: Farigiraf(Quiet,MentalHerb,ArmorTail—fainted G1; blocks priority targeting their side), Gholdengo(Modest,LifeOrb,GoodAsGold—blocks status moves targeting it; Make It Rain spread 2x SE vs Dark/Fairy, 67-151% to Grimmsnarl at 0.75x spread, possible OHKO; Hydro Pump+LO recoil can KO at 90%), Hydreigon(Modest,ChoiceScarf,Levitate,118-150Spe—not brought G1), Rotom-Wash(Bold,Sitrus,Levitate,106-138Spe; Thunderbolt 44-96% on Politoed, Make It Rain 0.5x on Politoed only 14-31%), Azumarill(Adamant,ExpertBelt,HugePower—not brought G1), Mudsdale(Brave,Leftovers,Stamina,49-78Spe; EQ 2x SE vs Scizor, Heavy Slam 4x SE vs Grimmsnarl, rain Hydro Pump 2x SE vs Mudsdale). Scizor cannot damage Gholdengo (Ghost immune to Fighting Close Combat, Steel resists Bullet Punch 0.5x, Bug resisted by Steel 0.5x for U-turn). Plan: KO Gholdengo via Hydro Pump+LO recoil chip; if Grimmsnarl survives Make It Rain, use Parting Shot/Reflect support; if Grimmsnarl falls, Politoed+Scizor pivot with Politoed rain Hydro Pump on Gholdengo then Mudsdale. Rain has 2 turns left (T4-T5).

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Rotom Protects vs Fake Out/attacks. Gholdengo outruns Politoed to deliver Make It Rain (likely OHKO Grimmsnarl + chip Politoed). Even if Politoed then KOs Gholdengo, we trade 1-for-1 and Rotom stays healthy. Safe, productive, and maintains endgame options.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads Politoed+Drizzle w/ Archaludon (fainted). Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks status. Farigiraf (Armor Tail) fainted — Prankster priority works now. Politoed rain Hydro Pump OHKOs Gholdengo from 90%. Back threats: Noivern (Life Orb, Infiltrator, Hurr in rain), Scizor-Mega (Tech BulletPunch), Staraptor (Sash, Intimidate, FinalGambit). Future: bring Mudsdale to set TR vs their fast threats; burn Scizor/Staraptor with Rotom; Gholdengo Make It Rain pressures Fairies. Opponent plays aggressively — used Electro Shot + HH turn 3 to nuke.

decisions.rationale: Hydro Pump easily KOs Gholdengo at 12% (31% min in rain > 12% HP). Close Combat chips Rotom-Wash 22-75% (higher with Mega Atk boost). If Gholdengo Protects, only Hydro Pump PP wasted; Gholdengo still at 12% next turn. If Gholdengo switches to Mudsdale, Hydro Pump hits 2x SE in rain. Mega Evolve now for Atk/Def boost vs Mudsdale endgame. Politoed has Sitrus Berry to survive Thunderbolt.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster: Farigiraf(Quiet,MentalHerb,ArmorTail—fainted G1; blocks priority targeting their side), Gholdengo(Modest,LifeOrb,GoodAsGold—blocks status moves targeting it; Make It Rain spread 2x SE vs Dark/Fairy, 67-151% to Grimmsnarl at 0.75x spread, possible OHKO; Hydro Pump+LO recoil can KO at 90%), Hydreigon(Modest,ChoiceScarf,Levitate,118-150Spe—not brought G1), Rotom-Wash(Bold,Sitrus,Levitate,106-138Spe; Thunderbolt 36-118% on Politoed, potential OHKO at high end; Make It Rain 0.5x on Politoed only 14-31%), Azumarill(Adamant,ExpertBelt,HugePower—not brought G1), Mudsdale(Brave,Leftovers,Stamina,49-78Spe; EQ 2x SE vs Scizor, Heavy Slam 4x SE vs Grimmsnarl, rain Hydro Pump 2x SE vs Mudsdale). Scizor cannot damage Gholdengo (Ghost immune to Fighting Close Combat, Steel resists Bullet Punch 0.5x, Bug resisted by Steel 0.5x for U-turn). Close Combat Scizor on Rotom-Wash: 22-75% (neutral). Hydro Pump Politoed on Gholdengo in rain: 31-108% (neutral, easily KOs at 12%). Politoed Drizzle won't re-set rain unless it switches out and back in (impossible with no bench). After rain ends, Hydro Pump still 2x SE vs Mudsdale but without 1.5x weather boost. Plan: KO Gholdengo via Hydro Pump, chip Rotom-Wash with Mega Close Combat, then Hydro Pump Mudsdale (2x SE even without rain). Scizor-Mega raw Speed 95-127 overlaps Rotom-Wash 106-138, speed order uncertain post-Mega.

decisions.rationale: Gholdengo at 13% HP must Protect to survive rain-boosted Hydro Pump from Politoed (~59-91%). Rotom Thunderbolt chips Politoed (43-77% super effective) without triggering Protect. Scizor-Mega Bullet Punch is weak to Gholdengo, and Close Combat/U-turn fail vs Ghost. This preserves board position for next-turn KO.
decisions.notebook: Opponent Drizzle Politoed aggressive rain Hydro Pumps. Farigiraf (Armor Tail) fainted → Prankster priority works again. Backline: Noivern Life Orb Infiltrator, Staraptor Sash Intimidate. Rotom SitrusBerry intact. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks status. Future: burn Scizor with Rotom Wisp next turn; bring Mudsdale vs no Water attacker or under TR.

decisions.rationale: Politoed must Protect or Thunderbolt KOs it (64% vs 61% HP). Scizor Bullet Punch (+1 priority) targets Gholdengo at 12% for a possible KO (7.7-16.7%). Even if it doesn't KO, Gholdengo drops to ~0-4%, easily finished next turn. Avoids extra Close Combat defense drops. If Gholdengo Protects (reduced rate), no progress but Politoed stays safe at 61% for next turn cleanup.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster: Farigiraf(Quiet,MentalHerb,ArmorTail—fainted G1; blocks priority targeting their side), Gholdengo(Modest,LifeOrb,GoodAsGold—blocks status moves targeting it; Make It Rain spread 2x SE vs Dark/Fairy, 67-151% to Grimmsnarl at 0.75x spread, possible OHKO; Hydro Pump+LO recoil can KO at 90%), Hydreigon(Modest,ChoiceScarf,Levitate,118-150Spe—not brought G1), Rotom-Wash(Bold,Sitrus,Levitate,106-138Spe; Thunderbolt does ~64% to Politoed (observed: 100%->36%), potential KO at 61%; Make It Rain 0.5x on Politoed only 14-31%), Azumarill(Adamant,ExpertBelt,HugePower—not brought G1), Mudsdale(Brave,Leftovers,Stamina,49-78Spe; EQ 2x SE vs Scizor, Heavy Slam 4x SE vs Grimmsnarl, rain Hydro Pump 2x SE vs Mudsdale). Scizor cannot meaningfully damage Gholdengo (Bullet Punch 0.5x 7.7-16.7%, U-turn 0.5x, Close Combat immune). Politoed Hydro Pump on Gholdengo neutral 26-57% (easy KO at 12% but 80% acc). Politoed Drizzle won't re-set rain unless it switches out and back in (impossible with no bench). After rain ends, Hydro Pump still 2x SE vs Mudsdale but without 1.5x weather boost. Ice Beam 2x SE vs Mudsdale (90 BP, 100% acc, no STAB) as reliable backup. Plan: Protect Politoed from Thunderbolt KO, chip/KO Gholdengo with Bullet Punch, then next turn finish Gholdengo if alive and pivot to dealing with Mudsdale via Politoed 2x SE moves. Scizor Close Combat on Rotom-Wash: 35-78% (neutral). Keep Scizor at -1/-1 rather than -2/-2 to survive Mudsdale EQ threat.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Burning Scizor neuters its physical attacks, while Gholdengo Protects to survive Bullet Punch. Next turn we safely double Politoed with Rotom/Gholdengo and switch Gholdengo to Mudsdale. Passive Protect stalls are unnecessary; attacking with Gholdengo is suicide.
decisions.notebook: Opponent Drizzle Politoed aggressive Hydro Pumps; Archaludon fainted; Grimmsnarl fainted. Backline: Noivern Life Orb Infiltrator, Staraptor Sash Intimidate. Rotom SitrusBerry intact. Gholdengo -2 SpA, 13% HP. Scizor -1 Def/SpD. Future: burn Scizor next turn, double Politoed, then pivot Mudsdale vs physical attackers. Avoid rain re-setting; no TR option left.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Helping Hand (priority +5) goes before Rotom, boosting Scizor Close Combat to ~47-103% on Rotom at 63% — strong KO chance. If Rotom Thunderbolts Politoed for the KO, we still likely remove Rotom, leaving Scizor 1v1 vs Mudsdale. If Rotom Protects or WoW instead, Politoed survives for next-turn Ice Beam on Mudsdale. Politoed is likely dead regardless; maximizing Rotom KO odds is the win condition.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster: Farigiraf(Quiet,MentalHerb,ArmorTail—fainted G1), Gholdengo(Modest,LifeOrb,GoodAsGold—fainted G1), Hydreigon(Modest,ChoiceScarf,Levitate,118-150Spe—not brought G1), Rotom-Wash(Bold,Sitrus,Levitate,106-138Spe; Thunderbolt ~64% to Politoed), Azumarill(Adamant,ExpertBelt,HugePower—not brought G1), Mudsdale(Brave,Leftovers,Stamina,49-78Spe; EQ spread 20-42% to Scizor at -1 Def, Stamina boosts Def on every hit taken). Scizor cannot meaningfully damage Rotom (BP 0.25x, U-turn neutral but weak). Close Combat is Scizor's only real answer to Rotom. Mudsdale Stamina makes physical attackers ineffective after first hit; special moves (Ice Beam/Hydro Pump) are the answer. G2 plan: lead differently to avoid Gholdengo Make It Rain wiping Grimmsnarl; consider Archaludon+Politoed rain opener or Grimmsnarl Reflect to survive.

decisions.rationale: Protect Mudsdale from risky Hydro Pump/Close Combat double target. Thunderbolt is 100% accurate, super effective, likely OHKO Politoed at 60%. Removes Drizzle, leaving Scizor alone next turn to burn and clean up.
decisions.notebook: Opponent backline: Life Orb Infiltrator Noivern, Sash Intimidate Staraptor. Scizor -1 Def/SpD after Close Combat. Politoed aggressive Hydro Pump usage. No TR left. Goal: burn Scizor and remove remaining mons with Mudsdale bulk. Rotom SitrusBerry intact, pivot for Staraptor intimation.

decisions.rationale: Helping Hand (priority +5) fires before Politoed can die. With HH, Close Combat does 52.5-97.2% to Rotom — guaranteed KO at 35% HP. Without HH, min roll is 35%, exactly matching Rotom's HP — too risky. Even if Will-O-Wisp burns Scizor (85% acc, missed twice), HH-boosted burned CC maxes at 48.6%, still a chance to KO. Best play to remove Rotom and give Scizor a slim 1v1 vs Mudsdale.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster: Farigiraf(Quiet,MentalHerb,ArmorTail—fainted G1), Gholdengo(Modest,LifeOrb,GoodAsGold—fainted G1), Hydreigon(Modest,ChoiceScarf,Levitate,118-150Spe—not brought G1), Rotom-Wash(Bold,Sitrus,Levitate,106-138Spe; Will-O-Wisp missed twice at 85% acc; Thunderbolt KOs Politoed), Azumarill(Adamant,ExpertBelt,HugePower—not brought G1), Mudsdale(Brave,Leftovers,Stamina,49-78Spe; EQ spread 20-42% to Scizor at -1 Def base, ~40-84% at -2 Def; Body Press ~15-30% base, ~29-61% at -2 Def; Stamina boosts Def on every physical hit, special moves bypass it). Scizor CC vs Rotom: 35-64.8% without HH, 52.5-97.2% with HH. Scizor cannot damage Rotom with Bullet Punch (0.25x). Close Combat is only real answer to Rotom. G1 likely lost: Scizor at -2 Def/-2 SpD cannot win vs Mudsdale Stamina endgame. G2 plan: lead differently to avoid Gholdengo Make It Rain wiping Grimmsnarl; consider Archaludon+Politoed rain opener or Grimmsnarl Reflect first. Opponent tends to Protect predictably (Rotom Protected turn 4, Mudsdale Protected turns 6-7). Opponent may not bring same 4 next game.

decisions.rationale: Politoed at 2% is easily KO'd by Mudsdale Body Press (guaranteed from range). Rotom at 36% risks being KO'd by Scizor's Close Combat if speed favors Scizor (95-127 vs 108). Protecting Rotom guarantees its survival, then Mudsdale KOs Politoed. Scizor then hits Mudsdale (34.5-49% from CC) leaving both alive for next turn vs Scizor + incoming Noivern/Staraptor.
decisions.notebook: Opponent backline: Life Orb Infiltrator Noivern, Sash Intimidate Staraptor. Scizor has -2 Def/SpD after repeated Close Combats; still physical threat. Politoed aggressive Hydro Pump usage but now sacrificial. No TR left. Rotom Sitrus already consumed, Protect preserved for pivoting. Mudsdale Protect success rate reduced next use. Goal: cleanly remove Politoed this turn, then handle Scizor+threat with intact Rotom+Mudsdale next turn.

decisions.rationale: Close Combat guaranteed KOs Rotom at 35% HP. Rotom outspeeds and may OHKO at -2 SpD, but Protect stalls with no win condition and no switch options remain. Only play that removes a threat and gives any chance, however slim, to reach a 1v1. Go down fighting.
decisions.notebook: G1 essentially lost. G2 prep: Opponent brought Farigiraf/Gholdengo/Rotom-W/Mudsdale G1; may swap in Hydreigon(Scarf) or Azumarill(Belt) G2. Gholdengo Make It Rain crit-KO'd Grimmsnarl through Reflect — avoid leading Grimm into Gholdengo. Mudsdale Stamina walls physical attackers; need special hits (Archaludon Flash Cannon/Electro Shot, Politoed Ice Beam neutral). Scizor Bullet Punch does 0.25x to Rotom — only Close Combat answers it. Rotom WoW missed twice at 85% (unlucky for opp). Opponent Protects predictably when threatened. G2 lead options: Archaludon+Politoed rain for Electro Shot sweep, or Grimm Reflect away from Gholdengo. Keep Scizor for late-game vs Gholdengo/Mudsdale. Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks priority — account for this if brought again.

decisions.rationale: Scizor likely Close Combats Rotom first (KO threat). Wisp first ensures burn halves its Attack before any retaliation; Mudsdale Body Press at -2 Def (~2x effective damage, 35-60%) plus burn chip secures the 2v1. If Rotom faints, burned Scizor is harmless to Mudsdale. Protects vs both wasted.
